# SECTION 1: PRODUCT OVERVIEW
# Source: docs/what-is-accesssync.html

## What Is AccessSync?

AccessSync is a Wix App Market SaaS that automates physical door access control
for gym and fitness operators.

**The problem it solves:**
Gym operators using Kisi for door access had to manually provision every new member.
When a member signs up on Wix, someone had to log into Kisi, find the member, add them
to the right group, and send credentials. When they cancelled, someone had to remove them.
This took 5–15 minutes per member and was constantly failing — members locked out,
cancelled members still getting in.

**What AccessSync does:**
When a member purchases a Wix pricing plan, AccessSync automatically provisions their
access credentials in Kisi. When they cancel or their payment fails, access is revoked.
No manual operator action required for any event.

**Pricing:**
- Base: $30/month/location — up to 2 active plans, 1 door, up to 200 members
- Pro: $60/month/location — unlimited plans, up to 5 doors, up to 500 members
- Connect: $150/month/location — unlimited everything, multi-location, API access

**Infrastructure cost:** $35/month fixed (Railway $15 + Wix Studio $20)
**Unit economics:** ~99% margin at scale

**First client:** House of Gains (Chad) — Kisi Pro tier, $199/mo/location
**Platform:** Node.js on Railway. Database: Postgres. Queue: BullMQ + Redis.
**Status:** V1 code-complete, pre-launch pending business gates.

**The 4-step flow:**
1. Member purchases a Wix pricing plan
2. Wix fires a webhook → AccessSync receives and verifies (HMAC-SHA256)
3. AccessSync looks up the plan → finds the matching Kisi group → grants role assignment
4. Member receives Kisi app invite and has door access

The same flow runs in reverse on cancellation, payment failure, or member deletion.

---

# SECTION 2: ARCHITECTURE
# Source: docs/architecture.html + llms.txt

## 7-Layer Architecture (DR-022)

AccessSync is a platform-agnostic access provisioning engine. Wix and Kisi are the
first adapters. Every new integration multiplies every existing one.

```
L1  adapters/wix/wix-connector.js       HTTP handler, HMAC-SHA256 verification
L2  adapters/wix/wix-adapter.js         Wix payload parsing → standard event object
L3  adapters/standard-adapter.js        Owns member_identity, member_access_state, in_flight lock
L4  core/                               Core Engine — queue, grant/revoke logic, reconciliation
L5  adapters/hardware-adapter.js        Platform router — delegates by hardwarePlatform string
L6  adapters/kisi/kisi-adapter.js       Kisi business methods
L7  adapters/kisi/kisi-connector.js     Kisi HTTP client, rate limiting
```

**Layer ownership rules (DR-023):**
- Layer 3 (Standard Adapter) EXCLUSIVELY owns member_identity UPSERT and member_access_state writes
- Core Engine (Layer 4) NEVER writes these tables directly
- Hardware platform is resolved from DB — Core Engine never hardcodes 'kisi' (DR-035)

**Backward-compat shims (DR-022):**
- adapters/wix-adapter.js → Layer 1 shim
- adapters/kisi-adapter.js → Layer 6 shim
- adapters/seam-adapter.js → Layer 6 stub (post-V1)

## Standard Event Contract (DR-021)

All input adapters produce this normalized object:
```
{ eventType, platformMemberId, sourcePlatform, memberEmail, planId, tenantId }
```
Core Engine never references platform-specific IDs. Enables Squarespace, Brivo, etc.
with zero changes to Layers 3–5.

## Hardware Adapter Interface (Layer 5)

8 methods all hardware adapters must implement:
- findUserByEmail(platform, apiKey, email)
- createUser(platform, apiKey, email, name)
- assignRole(platform, apiKey, userId, groupId, options) — options.validUntil for time-bounded access (Gap 6)
- removeRole(platform, apiKey, userId, roleAssignmentId)
- suspendAccess(platform, apiKey, userId)
- enableAccess(platform, apiKey, userId)
- deleteUser(platform, apiKey, userId)
- getLocks(platform, apiKey) — returns normalized: { id, name, locked: boolean }

## Queue Layer

BullMQ + Railway Redis. webhook-processor.js enqueues 'grant'/'revoke' jobs.
queue-worker.js (concurrency: 20) coordinates:
resolveAndLock → resolveIdentity → grantRevokeLogic → completeGrant/Revoke

Dead-letter via worker.on('failed') → retry-engine → error_queue table.

# SECTION 3: DATA MODEL
# Source: docs/data-model.html + schema.sql

## Schema Note (DR-035)

schema.sql baseline still shows kisi_api_key and wix_plan_id.
After migrations/dr-035.sql runs on Railway, the live column names are:
- clients.hardware_api_key (was kisi_api_key)
- locations.hardware_api_key (was kisi_api_key)
- plan_mappings.source_plan_id (was wix_plan_id)

This document describes the LIVE state (post-migration).

## Foundation Tables

### clients (Tenants)
Layer ownership: multi-layer (admin routes + onboarding write; all layers read)
DR: DR-020, DR-025, DR-027, DR-028

Key columns:
- id (UUID PK)
- name — company name e.g. "House of Gains"
- platform — 'wix', 'squarespace'. DEFAULT 'wix'
- site_id (UNIQUE) — platform site identifier, webhook routing, self-registered on first webhook
- hardware_platform — 'kisi', 'seam' — which hardware provider
- tier — 'Base', 'Pro', 'Connect'
- status — DEFAULT 'active'
- notification_email — per-tenant operator alert destination (DR-020). Set via UI. Distinct from ACCESSSYNC_OWNER_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL env var.
- last_sync_at — DR-018: single timestamp, updated on each sync sweep
- hardware_api_key — DR-028: AES-256-GCM encrypted org-level API key (schema.sql shows kisi_api_key — DR-035 renames)
- first_grant_sent — BOOLEAN. Sprint 5.5: atomic flag for first grant welcome email.

### locations (Physical Sites per Client)
Layer ownership: foundation
DR: DR-025, DR-027, DR-028

Key columns:
- id (UUID PK), client_id (FK → clients)
- name, city, state
- subscription_status — DEFAULT 'inactive'. Values: inactive, active, lapsed. Provisioning gated on 'active' (DR-027).
- tier, subscribed_at, subscription_id — DR-027 billing fields
- hardware_api_key — nullable per-location override. Null = use client.hardware_api_key. (DR-028)
- hardware_key_last_verified, hardware_key_last_error — Sprint 5.2 health check fields

### plan_mappings (The Translator)
Layer ownership: Layer 4 (Core Engine reads)
DR: DR-025, DR-026, DR-035

Key columns:
- id (UUID PK), client_id (FK)
- source_plan_id — DR-035: was wix_plan_id. The Wix pricing plan ID.
- hardware_group_id — the Kisi/Seam group ID
- location_id (FK, nullable), plan_name, door_name, status
- access_type — DEFAULT 'group'. Future: 'zone'/'door' for Seam.

### processed_event_ids (Idempotency)
Layer ownership: Layer 4
DR: DR-010

event_id (VARCHAR PK) — Wix Event ID.
webhook-processor.js checks before enqueuing. Duplicates silently dropped.

### error_queue (Dead Letter Queue)
Layer ownership: Layer 4
DR: DR-025

Stores jobs that exhaust retry-engine backoff. Operator dismisses with note.
Key columns: client_id, member_id, event_type, payload, error_reason, retry_count, status,
dismiss_note, dismissed_by, location_id, plan_name, door_name.

## Access Adapter Layer (Layer 3 owned — DR-023)

### member_identity
DR: DR-001, DR-003, DR-021, DR-023

- id (UUID PK), client_id (FK)
- platform_member_id — DR-021: was wix_member_id. Platform-agnostic member ID.
- source_platform — DR-021: 'wix', 'squarespace'. DEFAULT 'wix'.
- hardware_platform — 'kisi', 'seam'
- hardware_user_id — generated ID in Kisi/Seam. NULL until resolveIdentity() runs.
- source_tag — DR-003: DEFAULT 'accesssync'. Reconciliation scope boundary.
- UNIQUE(client_id, source_platform, platform_member_id)
- NO email/name stored — data minimization (DR-001). Fetched from Wix on-demand.

### member_access_state
DR: DR-011, DR-023

- id (UUID PK), member_id (FK, UNIQUE), client_id (FK)
- status — pending_sync | in_flight | active | disabled | revoked | failed | skipped_lockdown
- in_flight = concurrency lock (DR-011). Concurrent operations rejected while set.
- role_assignment_id — legacy single Kisi role ID. Fallback for pre-DR-026 rows.
- provisioned_at — set by completeGrant()

### member_role_assignments (Multi-Door)
DR: DR-026

One row per hardware role assignment per member per plan mapping.
UNIQUE(member_id, mapping_id) — idempotent on retry.
completeRevoke() deletes all rows atomically.

- id (UUID PK), member_id (FK), mapping_id (FK), role_assignment_id, created_at

### member_access_log
DR: DR-004

Lifecycle events table. Not operational noise. Events: provisioning_started, provisioned,
provisioning_failed, disabled, restored, revoked.

### adapter_admin_log
DR: DR-019, DR-021

Provisioning audit trail. configured_by + configured_at (nullable, DR-019).

## Activity / Telemetry

### client_activity_summary
DR: DR-024. Layer 3 (Standard Adapter) owns writes.

Daily aggregated counts. UPSERT pattern. Fault-tolerant.
UNIQUE(client_id, summary_date).
Columns: events_received, grants_completed, revokes_completed, errors_count.

### config_alert_log

Operator configuration issue tracking.
alert_type: missing_door, missing_group, expired_credentials, location_mismatch.

## Observability

### webhook_log

Every inbound Wix webhook. Written by wix-connector.js before processing.
Key columns: event_id, client_id, received_at, hmac_status ('accepted'/'rejected'),
dedup_status ('new'/'duplicate'), event_type, raw_payload, normalized_payload, error_detail.

# SECTION 4: DECISION LOG
# Source: docs/decision-log.html + DECISION_LOG.md + CLAUDE.md

## All 35 Locked Decisions — DO NOT REVISIT WITHOUT SAGE

Data & Schema:
DR-001  No PII storage — email/name never stored in DB. Re-fetched from Wix on-demand at reconciliation.
DR-003  source_tag='accesssync' on all managed users — reconciliation scope boundary
DR-004  member_access_log — lifecycle table only, not operational noise
DR-013  member_identity A/B pattern — platform-agnostic. Column names superseded by DR-021.
DR-018  last_sync_at as column on clients table (not separate sync_state table). V2 if needed.
DR-019  adapter_admin_log — configured_by + configured_at (nullable columns)
DR-021  Platform-agnostic member_identity. wix_member_id → platform_member_id. UNIQUE(client_id, source_platform, platform_member_id).
DR-024  client_activity_summary — Layer 3 daily UPSERT. Fault-tolerant. Never blocks grant/revoke.
DR-025  locations table + plan_mappings.location_id/plan_name/door_name/status + error_queue additions.
DR-026  Multi-door: member_role_assignments table. UNIQUE(member_id, mapping_id). payment.recovered = enableAccess only. UnrecoverableError for 4xx.
DR-027  Per-location subscription model. subscription_status gating. Location lapse flow required.
DR-028  hardware_api_key AES-256-GCM encrypted. clients (org) + locations (nullable override). KISI_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var. NEVER store plaintext.
DR-029  Sub-member ID format: {uuid}###as{NNN}. Deterministic, reversible, collision-free.
DR-030  plan_holder_id column links sub-members to primary member.
DR-034  member_access_sources — multi-source grant/revoke. Pre-grant check. Revoke only when zero sources.
DR-035  kisi_api_key → hardware_api_key (clients + locations). wix_plan_id → source_plan_id (plan_mappings). Migration: dr-035.sql.

Architecture:
DR-002  Access Adapter Layer is bidirectional identity bridge between platform and hardware IDs.
DR-010  Idempotency via processed_event_ids table. Duplicates silently dropped.
DR-011  in_flight status = concurrency lock. Concurrent grant/revoke for same member rejected.
DR-022  7-layer architecture. Do not collapse layers. Backward-compat shims.
DR-023  Layer 3 (Standard Adapter) exclusively owns member_identity writes and member_access_state writes. Core Engine (Layer 4) never writes these tables.
DR-031  Family plan: upstream explosion in Layer 2 (Wix Adapter). Core Engine unchanged.

Infrastructure:
DR-001  (hosting) Railway as hosting platform.
DR-009  HMAC-SHA256 on all Wix webhooks. WIX_WEBHOOK_SECRET required.
DR-012  BullMQ queue on Railway Redis. Crons: reconciliation (nightly) + health check (every 6h).

Product:
DR-005  Kisi lockdown override — skip (not fail) during lockdown.
DR-006  Member sync screen — one-time post-purchase UI. Not a persistent dashboard.
DR-007  Kisi managed users, send_emails: false. HOG exception: DR-017.
DR-008  Pricing locked: $30/$60/$150. Tier names: Base/Pro/Connect.
DR-011  (kisi) Kisi routes direct API, not through Seam.
DR-016  Velo direct install for House of Gains Phase 1 (not App Market).
DR-017  HOG exception: regular users (not managed). DR-007 still active for all other clients.
DR-020  Operator email via Resend SDK. clients.notification_email per-tenant. ACCESSSYNC_OWNER_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL = platform fallback.
DR-032  Family plan draft→submit workflow. No provisioning until submit.
DR-033  Unified member widget — single screen with planType param: 'plan', 'event', 'family'.

Legal:
DR-009  (legal) Kisi API connector model, Section 2.3(ii) flag resolved. Attorney review pending.

UI:
DR-014  Color system: Indigo #4F6EF7 (--brand) / Sage #4ADE80 (--sage). Non-interchangeable.
DR-015  Mobile-first: 320px baseline. FORGE + LENS enforce.

## Status Summary
Live: 22 | Planned: 11 | Backlog: 3 | Total: 38

## Core Features — Single Member Access

F001  Plan-to-Group Grant           LIVE    Wix plan.purchased → Kisi group role assignment
F002  Plan Revoke                   LIVE    Wix plan.cancelled → delete Kisi role assignment
F003  Payment Suspension            LIVE    Wix payment.failed → Kisi access_enabled: false
F004  Payment Recovery              LIVE    Wix payment.recovered → enableAccess only (no new roles, DR-026)
F005  Member Deletion               LIVE    Wix member.deleted → DELETE Kisi user
F006  Webhook Deduplication         LIVE    processed_event_ids — before BullMQ enqueue
F007  Identity Resolution           LIVE    DB cache → findUserByEmail → createUser
F008  Multi-Door Provisioning       LIVE    member_role_assignments — one row per door per member
F009  Multi-Source Grant/Revoke     PLANNED member_access_sources table (DR-034). Not yet built.
F010  Nightly Reconciliation        LIVE    AccessSync ↔ Kisi state sweep, drift correction

## Family Plan Features (all PLANNED — zero code)

F020  Sub-Member ID Generation      PLANNED {uuid}###as{NNN} format (DR-029)
F021  Plan Holder Linkage           PLANNED plan_holder_id column (DR-030)
F022  Upstream Explosion            PLANNED Layer 2 explodes family webhooks (DR-031)
F023  Draft-Submit Workflow         PLANNED No provisioning until submit (DR-032)
F024  Unified Member Widget         PLANNED planType param: plan/event/family (DR-033)
F025  Family Suspension             PLANNED payment.failed suspends holder + sub-members
F026  Family Revoke Cascade         PLANNED plan.cancelled → revoke all sub-members

## Operator UI Features (all LIVE)

F037  Owner Bypass PIN              LIVE    Location activation without Kisi key

## Integration Features

I001  Kisi Direct API               LIVE    Direct REST, not Seam (DR-011)

# SECTION 6: OPERATIONS
# Source: docs/operations.html + CLAUDE.md

## Railway Services

Core Engine:    node server.js             (always on)
Admin Hub:      node admin/server.js       (always on)
Cron 1:         node core/reconciliation.js          (nightly)
Cron 2:         node core/hardware-health-check.js   (every 6 hours)
Health checks:  GET /health on both services

## Environment Variables — Core Engine

DATABASE_URL                         PostgreSQL connection string (Railway)
WIX_WEBHOOK_SECRET                   HMAC secret from Wix developer dashboard
KISI_ENCRYPTION_KEY                  32-byte hex for AES-256-GCM (hardware_api_key encryption)
RESEND_API_KEY                       Resend API key (resend.com) — DR-020, OB-51 open
RESEND_FROM_EMAIL                    Sender address e.g. alerts@accesssync.io — OB-51 open
ACCESSSYNC_OWNER_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL  Platform owner email (Daxx). HMAC alerts + reconciliation digests + client notification fallback. NOT per-tenant.
PORT                                 Set by Railway automatically
NODE_ENV                             development | production
DEFAULT_TENANT_ID                    Temporary — remove when multi-tenant routing complete

## Environment Variables — Admin Hub

ADMIN_JWT_SECRET                     64-char random string — JWT signing
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID                     OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Google Cloud Console)
ADMIN_ALLOWED_EMAIL                  daxxroberts@gmail.com — only this account can log in
OWNER_PIN                            Bypass PIN for onboarding (skips Kisi key validation)
OPERATOR_INVITE_TOKEN                Shared secret for onboarding signup endpoints (OB-24)
CORE_ENGINE_URL                      Core Engine Railway URL — used by onboarding Step 5 (OB-25 open)

## Adapters

adapters/wix/wix-connector.js        L1: HTTP + HMAC + hmac-monitor wiring
adapters/wix/wix-adapter.js          L2: Wix payload parsing only
adapters/standard-adapter.js         L3: identity/state/lock owner + first grant email
adapters/hardware-adapter.js         L5: platform router + Gap 6 (validUntil)
adapters/kisi/kisi-adapter.js        L6: Kisi methods + normalized getLocks()
adapters/kisi/kisi-connector.js      L7: Kisi HTTP + rate limiting (5 req/sec)
adapters/seam/seam-adapter.js        L6 stub — post-V1

## Core

core/webhook-processor.js            BullMQ enqueue + dedup
core/queue-worker.js                 Layer coordinator (concurrency: 20)
core/grant-revoke.js                 Pure grant/revoke logic
core/plan-mapping-resolver.js        source_plan_id → hardware_group_id lookup
core/retry-engine.js                 Exponential backoff + dead letter
core/reconciliation.js              Nightly sweep + operator digest
core/hmac-monitor.js                 Redis HMAC spike alerting (Sprint 5.1)
core/hardware-health-check.js        6-hourly key validation (Sprint 5.2)
core/member-sync-api.js              RS256 JWT-verified member status API
core/tenant-resolver.js              site_id → client_id (5-min cache)
core/crypto-utils.js                 AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt
core/location-lapse.js               Suspend all members at location on lapse

## Admin

admin/server.js                      Crash-isolated Express app + 6 EJS page routes
admin/routes/operator.js             Operator dashboard API (34+ endpoints)
admin/routes/clients.js              Clients panel (Admin JWT required)
admin/routes/errors.js               Error queue management
admin/routes/members.js              Debug center with email search
admin/public/onboard.html            5-step operator onboarding wizard

## Schema + Migrations
